report.pitch_help: Signal activity 0% (smoothed, not a peak or clipping meter). Arrow keys adjust; Shift for fine adjustment; Home/End for limits; F2 enters a value. Deck pitch. Percent; selected ±8, ±16 or ±50 range. Adjust playback rate around zero. Pitch lock determines whether the file's pitch follows the rate. Center resets to the original rate.

other_attempts.detail: Missing formatted English template, overconfident synthetic test expectation and legitimate fully trimmed MP3 terminal padding exposed; fixed template/assertion and actual decoder padding handling.
Native test used a private busy field and misspelled wait helper; corrected against actual APIs.
Test looked for static text in AccessKit label instead of value. A diagnostic window-height change did not help and was reverted.
New smart-crate regression initially guessed APIs; corrected against the actual location/hash/incremental APIs. Native filter assertion counted factory rows; corrected to assert source membership.
Missing CARGO_HOME prevented offline metadata resolution; retry long-8b used the project-owned dependency cache and passed without source changes.

limits: Whole-source major/minor only; no modulation timeline or tuning correction.
At most the first stereo pair or mono source informs the key estimate.
Correlation and margin are not probabilities.
The piano corpus was used during development and is not held out; no DJ or cross-genre accuracy claim.
Two incorrect returned estimates are retained; 19 correct of 21 returned, 27 unknown of 48.
Key comparison uses source pitch, not deck pitch adjustments, and cannot promise a musical transition.
Private/dummy audio graphs and native software accessibility paths are not physical listening, controller, converter, screen-reader or hardware qualification.
Long mixed-format callback evidence is functional; no deadline or hardware-xrun claim.
Local package verified only; not published or installed.
